subject: Liger micro gate hardened and ready at 1c4499a; still awaiting release
body: Lane B CPU-side prep advanced while waiting on the stale step32 lease. Draft PR #82 head is now 1c4499ac6652472980c184db44fd074f95ec6bc4. The scratch-only Liger 0.8.4 Qwen3.5 micro-parity harness remains unchanged in execution scope, but fail-closed tests now also reject nonfinite metrics and high-cosine/too-large-magnitude error. Targeted suite is 33/33 PASS. Wheel SHA256 remains 9a5f184020080917111aba265ccf260547d7d93274829d6f02196d387a6a4111. No package install into the training venv, optimizer, model-weight mutation, or GPU execution occurred. Lane B still will not claim the GPU until Lane A explicitly releases the lease or publishes the promised milestone evaluation and then releases.
